definitionZh: CSS 属性选择器匹配基于特定属性明确设定的元素的元素,以及定义属性值或子字符串值匹配的选项.
sourceDefinition: The CSS attribute selector matches elements based on the element having a given attribute explicitly set, with options for defining an attribute value or substring value match.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The CSS attribute selector matches elements based on the element having a given attribute explicitly set, with options for defining an attribute value or substring value match.
